scenes.title: The missing layer
scenes.voiceover: A payment link is easy. Reconciliation is not. Merchants need proof of what was requested, what settled, and which exceptions still need attention.

captions.text: A payment link is easy. Reconciliation is not. Merchants need proof of what was requested, what settled, and which exceptions still need attention.

visual.intent: From payment link to auditable settlement

scenes.title: Supervised ZeroClaw
scenes.voiceover: The merchant asks ZeroClaw to charge an order. A supervised tool call creates the invoice, while the agent holds no wallet key and cannot move funds.

captions.text: The merchant asks ZeroClaw to charge an order. A supervised tool call creates the invoice, while the agent holds no wallet key and cannot move funds.

visual.intent: One approved tool call. Zero custody.

scenes.title: A signed offer
scenes.voiceover: Each invoice gets a payment identifier, expiry, unique Solana Pay reference, canonical offer hash, and a non-funds Ed25519 issuer attestation.

captions.text: Each invoice gets a payment identifier, expiry, unique Solana Pay reference, canonical offer hash, and a non-funds Ed25519 issuer attestation.

scenes.title: Real Solana execution
scenes.voiceover: This is not the simulation path. An ephemeral payer signs a zero point zero zero one SOL transfer on a fresh Agave validator, with the exact recipient, memo, and reference.

captions.text: This is not the simulation path. An ephemeral payer signs a zero point zero zero one SOL transfer on a fresh Agave validator, with the exact recipient, memo, and reference.

visual.intent: Signed transaction. Confirmed slot. No error.

scenes.title: Proof that travels
scenes.voiceover: The cashier validates the transfer, records the witness evidence, signs the settlement hash, and exports a bundle that verifies offline. The result is accepted with no anomalies.

captions.text: The cashier validates the transfer, records the witness evidence, signs the settlement hash, and exports a bundle that verifies offline. The result is accepted with no anomalies.

visual.intent: Offer hash, proof hash, issuer key, offline verification

scenes.title: Fail closed
scenes.voiceover: Late, duplicate, underpaid, overpaid, invalid, or disputed payments enter an attention queue. Refunds require owner approval. The final boundary remains T1: the human wallet signs.

captions.text: Late, duplicate, underpaid, overpaid, invalid, or disputed payments enter an attention queue. Refunds require owner approval. The final boundary remains T1: the human wallet signs.

scenes.title: Reproducible
scenes.voiceover: Twenty-six TypeScript tests and six Rust verifier tests pass. The ZeroClaw skill audit and both SOPs validate. One command independently checks the public proof. Proof-Carrying Cashier is ready to review.

captions.text: Twenty-six TypeScript tests and six Rust verifier tests pass. The ZeroClaw skill audit and both SOPs validate. One command independently checks the public proof. Proof-Carrying Cashier is ready to review.

visual.intent: 26 TypeScript tests. 6 Rust tests. Independent public proof.
